basic_profile.bio: A passionate home chef based in Bangalore, India, with a deep love for Indian cuisine and a knack for blending traditional recipes with modern health trends. I work as a software developer and often find solace in cooking after long coding marathons. My weekends are usually spent experimenting with new dishes or exploring the vibrant food scene in the city. I am married with one child, and our little family loves to travel and taste diverse cuisines. My online presence peaks in the evenings, post-work hours.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science and work in the tech industry, but cooking has been my lifelong passion. Most of my culinary knowledge comes from family traditions and self-study through cookbooks and online resources. I also attend local cooking classes occasionally.
